title: Six sequence tests do not reject time-independent measured dips in HD 139139 under paired exchangeability
abstract: We test the order of the durations and depths of 28 listed HD 139139 dips. Paired permutations preserve the relation between duration and depth. A joint search for trends, changes and serial relations gives p = 0.10098. A depth alternation test alone gives 0.02962, but removal of the paper's suspect event raises the joint p to 0.55625. Simulated moderate ordering changes have low detection power. The result does not establish a stationary physical source. No new dip, object or independent confirmation is found. The test adds a sequence check to earlier rate and marginal-duration tests. Stable measurement and selection are necessary assumptions. Original code, aggregate evidence, a figure and exact external-source retrieval steps are included. Source records stay external.

display.caption: Six marginal tests and conditional power. The joint p is 0.101. Trend and serial strengths are latent correlations; step strength is a latent Gaussian shift.
